_comment: sg13g2-bandgap -- record spec for sg13cmos5l-closed-loop-startup-pex on the `klt sim` harness (issue #337, Part of #322).
The per-experiment half of the adapter contract: sim/harness/klt_sim_evidence.py owns the record MECHANICS and takes
every piece of ARGUMENT from this file. Narrative is carried over from the legacy run_pvt_sweep.sh record text; it is not a new claim.
Infrastructure/plumbing evidence for issue #65's port, NOT a claim against any ratified spec row (spec/ tracks no ratified SG13CMOS5L accuracy target).
Claim: co-simulating, with every MOS device's geometry (w/l + drawn junction as/ad/ps/pd) taken from the routed layout/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top extraction rather than the schematic's junction-less defaults, SG13CMOS5L's bandgap_core + bandgap_amp + bandgap_startup (design/sg13cmos5l/, issues #64/#68) in one netlist (design/sg13cmos5l/bandgap_top.sch's own wiring: core.fb <- amp.out, core.sns1 -> amp.in_n, core.sns2 -> amp.in_p, startup shares sns1 and fb with the core), with vdd itself ramped 0 -> VDD over 200 us, the assembled block self-starts and settles to a closed-loop operating point across the full temperature x supply x pnpMPA/MOS/resistor-process-corner PVT grid: the startup circuit fully releases (v(det) <= 0.2*vdd, |i(XMKFB)| <= 50 nA), the real error amplifier closes the loop (|sns1-sns2| <= 20 mV), and fb settles to a real interior equilibrium rather than railing (fb within [0.05 V, vdd-0.05 V]). The three criteria are applied per point by sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py (same constants and formula as sim/lib/pvt_verdict_common.sh pvt_closed_loop_verdict, 3-criteria form). Closed-loop infrastructure/plumbing evidence, NOT a claim against any spec accuracy/PSRR/Iq target. Hybrid post-layout evidence: NO wire (metal) parasitics are modelled (klayout-tools#1440), bipolar devices and resistors stay schematic-sourced (klayout-tools#1242 / issue #176); see this directory's README.md.
Devices: XM1-3 (core), XMTAIL/XMP1-4/XMN1-4 (amp), XMSENSE/XMKFB (startup): 14 MOS devices with layout-extracted geometry re-encoded as X-subckt calls to sg13_hv_pmos/sg13_hv_nmos; XQ1-XQ3 (pnpMPA), XR1/XR2 (rppd), XRPU (rhigh) spliced verbatim from the schematic netlists.
Netlist provenance: layout/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top/sg13cmos5l-bandgap_top.pex.spice (device geometry hand-transcribed into the body template, as in the legacy template -- NOT generated; no sim/tools/gen_pex_netlist_body.py equivalent exists for this cell) + design/sg13cmos5l/netlist/*.spice for the schematic-sourced devices. Because the geometry is transcribed rather than generated, no extraction-source hashes are captured: a PEX record cannot be published until that binding exists (see sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json deferred_requirements.pex_binding).
PDK: `ihp-sg13cmos5l` -- the TARGET/SETUP pin in sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json (IHP-Open-PDK dev subtree, sibling `ihp-sg13g2/` required). No record has yet been generated on that pin, so runtime compatibility is UNVERIFIED until the first one exists; a record minted from this spec must be read against the pin its run actually resolved (report `environment`), not against this sentence. OSDI models: sim/pdk-sg13cmos5l.json "osdi_toolchain".
Corner matrix run: process {typ,bcs,wcs,sf,fs} x temperature {-40,27,125} C x supply {2.97,3.30,3.63} V (45 points) with pnpMPA x MOS-hv x resistor sections paired per sim/harness/cmos5l_klt.py CORNER_SECTIONS
